review_description: After an extensive search for the right solar installer, involving many calls and quotes (including some sourced through SolarQuotes), we actually discovered Innovate Electrical and Solar somewhat accidentally through positive online reviews. Choosing them turned out to be the best decision we could have made. We had Innovate install an 8.36kW solar array and a 40kWh Sigenergy battery, adding to our existing 7kW solar system. The entire process for this large, complex upgrade was remarkably smooth and professional from start to finish.Quoting and Sales: Leah in the office was outstanding. She was incredibly patient, answering all my (many!) technical questions with genuine expertise and making the quoting and financing process straightforward. Communication was always clear and prompt.Installation: The installation team, led by David, was exceptional. Their workmanship is top-notch – very neat, tidy, and clearly done with care. It's obvious they don't cut corners. What really stood out was David's commitment to ensuring everything was perfect. He didn't just install the system; he went the extra mile to ensure every component was communicating correctly and performing optimally. He even took the time to help fix some existing solar mesh around our older panels, which was completely unexpected and greatly appreciated. His final walkthrough and explanation of the system were also thorough and easy to understand.System Performance: The combined system is performing brilliantly. We've been amazed to see it generate significant power and charge the large battery even on overcast, rainy days – a testament to the quality components and smart design.Overall: If you're looking for a solar installer who is professional, knowledgeable, provides high-quality workmanship, and genuinely goes above and beyond for their customers, we wholeheartedly recommend Innovate Electrical and Solar. A truly 5-star experience.

We are very pleased with the service provided by Innovate Electrical and Solar. They fully and patiently explained the whole process beforehand and provided support with the monitoring app afterwards.The install itself was professional and tidyand was overall a stress free experience.

Innovate Electrical and Solar also installed my original solar system about four years ago, which has been running perfectly with zero issues ever since — a true testament to their workmanship and reliability.I highly recommend Innovate Electrical and Solar to anyone looking for reliable, honest, and professional solar and electrical services. They deliver great results, quality products, and outstanding customer care every step of the way!
